runtime.name: omp-package
runtime.configuration: Local generated package installed, reinstalled with force, and uninstalled through npm in a temporary prefix.
runtime.permissionProfile: Writes restricted to a disposable temporary prefix.

assertions.evidence: npm installed the generated OMP package and its omp.skills manifest into a new temporary prefix.
Forced reinstall completed and preserved a user-owned sibling sentinel.
npm uninstall removed the package while preserving the user-owned sibling sentinel.

limitations: This validates only the package artifact lifecycle used beneath OMP package installation and therefore does not satisfy D1.
The OMP plugin-manager dry-run probe failed its no-write invariant.
Live OMP discovery and invocation are covered by the related prove-it-works evidence.
